evidence.detail: Reviewed NpcIndicatorsPlugin rs/s/o/e owns exactly one rs/s/o/c overlay field and registers/unregisters that instance through the live overlay manager in its plugin lifecycle.
The overlay asks NpcIndicatorsPlugin for the reviewed HighlightedNpc value associated with its current R30 Npc target and renders only when such a highlight definition exists.

HighlightedNpc flags drive the complete overlay surface: model hull, tile, true tile, south-west tile variants, outline, overhead name and minimap-name rendering, using its exact highlight/fill colors, border width and feather.
The overlay base holds rs/a/j, independently recovered in R30 as Npc; it ignores invalid/hidden definitions and does not render any non-NPC domain.

candidates.note: NpcIndicatorsOverlay is fixed by exclusive NpcIndicatorsPlugin ownership, HighlightedNpc consumption and a whole-class NPC highlight render surface. Confidence is 0.999; adjacent rs/s/o/b remains unnamed because its cache/snapshot role is less specific.
